title: Roasted Potato Salad With Lemon and Feta
description: Roasting the potatoes rather than boiling them gives this potato salad great texture and deep caramelized flavor. Potatoes are a great canvas for all sorts of flavors; this salad pairs them with creamy feta, briny olives, punchy pepperoncini, juicy tomatoes and lots of herbs for a bright twist on a classic picnic side. Take care not to season the potatoes too heavily with salt, as the feta and olives will add lots on their own.
ingredients: 1 ½pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, plus more if needed
1 cup cherry or grape tomatoes, halved
½ cup roughly chopped pitted Kalamata olives
1-2 garlic cloves, finely minced or grated
directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. On a large rimmed baking sheet, toss the potatoes, 2 tablespoons olive oil and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Arrange in an even layer and cook until golden-brown and crisp, tossing about halfway through, about 35 minutes.
Let the potatoes cool for 5 minutes, then add them to a large bowl with the lemon juice. Toss to coat, then let cool to room temperature.

Add the tomatoes, olives, dill, parsley, pepperoncini, garlic, and remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to the bowl. Stir gently to combine, then sprinkle the feta over the top. Taste and add more lemon, salt and pepper if desired.
